name: Fursuit Dummy
check: A mannequin wearing a fursuit head. Smells like the previous owner.

acts.label: Talk
acts.text: * It doesn't seem much for conversation. Furiell seems happy.

acts.label: Accept Hug
acts.text: * You hug the dummy. It's damp. FUR +10.

default: * The damp fursuit head stares ahead.

deathText: * The dummy collapses into faux fur and regret.
